A Brave Maid

勇敢的女仆 · 146 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A wooden vase from the Ming Dynasty at the entrance of the reception hall amazed everyone. The artists designed it in a rare style and selected valuable jewels to decorate it. People thought highly of its rich honey colour and the beautiful paintings on it.

2The vase once belonged to a collection kept in a castle. But when the country was at war, the enemy troops blew up the castle. People kept debating how the vase had survived. To clear up the mystery, a team of no less than 20 people carried out an informal investigation. The evidence they found showed that a maid had taken the vase apart and asked a sailor to sink it in a local well. She never gave away the secret, even under cruel interrogation by enemies searching for treasure.

3The brave maid deserved a fortune in return for her courage.

勇敢的女仆

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1接待大厅入口处摆着一只明代的木花瓶，大家看到它都很惊讶。工匠设计的样式很少见，还挑了贵重的宝石装饰它。人们特别欣赏它漂亮的蜜色和瓶身上精美的画。

2这只花瓶原先放在一座古堡里。国家陷入战争时，敌军把古堡炸毁了。人们一直在争论，这只花瓶究竟是怎样保住的。为了解开疑问，一支至少二十人组成的小组做了非正式的调查。找到的证据显示，当年一名女仆把花瓶拆开，请一位水手把它沉入当地的一口井里。后来，搜寻财宝的敌人残酷地审问她，她也始终守着这个秘密。

3这位勇敢的女仆值得得到一大笔奖赏。
